newsitem.title: UK: BFI up one in quiet and uncertain market.
newsitem.headline: BFI up one in quiet and uncertain market.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose one point on Tuesday to 1,375 with brokers saying that very quiet conditons prevailed in the freight market, in particular for Capers and Handy-sizes.

Caper business was a at a very low level. Turnover was also poor in the grain trades although Cargill were reported to have booked a Caper and a Panamax for Mississippi to Amsterdam at $11.10 basis 55ft and $11.90 basis heavy grain respectively, both marginally better than rates agreed for similair business last week.
Brokers professed considerable uncertainty about the future course of the market.
The Baltic Handy Index was down one at 1,006 points.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 25 points down in the traded positions where turnover totalled only 29 lots.
